premises.text: Conventional water heaters waste water waiting for heat, are hard to control, inefficient, and fail when heating elements get hot
premises.evidence_span: Existing hot water heating technology doesn't save water. It's difficult to control the temperature. It's not energy efficient and the things inside that get really hot to heat the water break when they get really hot

premises.text: Fully electronic resistive heating of water itself delivers instant hot water without elements/burners at high efficiency and reliability
premises.evidence_span: using electronic controls and the natural resistance of the water itself to heat the water instantly without any heating elements or burners

premises.text: Wi-Fi/iOS controls enable temperature presets, usage/cost reporting, and utility peak-demand power capping
premises.evidence_span: our electronic controls are natural for Wi-Fi connectivity. So through our iOS app on the front page, you can actually adjust temperature settings and presets

premises.text: Model 1 can augment existing systems as booster, extender, or turbocharger creating new retrofit applications
premises.evidence_span: The Model 1 is the only product that you can install in your existing hot water system that will augment its performance

premises.text: Sold at ~$395 retail with pre-order/Kickstarter channel into homes needing full replace or retrofit
premises.evidence_span: At 395 retail, that's a $52 billion market

domains.name: electronic instant heating and app control

value.text: Proactive water and energy savings with reliable, luxurious instantaneous hot water
value.evidence_span: allows the user to proactively save water and energy while getting a reliable and luxurious water heating experience

causal_links.evidence_span: we all have to do it

we've created a whole brand new market
